Sample Person Eight
Data Analyst | SQL, Tableau and Python | Turning product and marketing data into decisions for subscription businesses
Pasadena, California

About
Data analyst specializing in SQL, Tableau, and Python for subscription businesses. I turn product and marketing data into the dashboards and analysis that teams use to decide what to build and where to spend.

For the last four years I have worked on growth analytics at Example Streaming, where I own the retention reporting used by product, marketing, and finance. I built the churn model that now drives our win-back campaigns, which lifted reactivations by 18% in its first two quarters. I designed the experiment readouts for more than 60 A/B tests and moved the team from one-off spreadsheets to a shared set of Tableau dashboards with 300 weekly viewers.

What I am good at: asking the question behind the question, writing SQL that other people can read, and explaining a result to someone who does not care about p-values. I have trained 25 colleagues in basic SQL so that simple questions no longer wait in a queue.

Before analytics I worked in customer support, and I still think the best insights start with what customers are actually saying. I pair every dashboard with a short written summary because a chart without a conclusion is homework for the reader.

Tools I use every day: SQL (Snowflake, BigQuery), Tableau, Python (pandas), dbt, and Excel when it is the right tool. I am currently learning more about forecasting and causal inference.

I am open to conversations about analytics roles in subscription, media, and consumer technology. Reach out here or at sample.eight@example.com. I answer every message.
